decisions.reason: The cobot loading system launched only in 2024 and its prospects are still uncertain, while keeping it as an automation add-on to the existing machines costs little, so the option is worth keeping open.
The dual-table loading system is a low-cost complementary option that the market has had only one year to test, which is too little evidence to justify abandoning it.
The dispensing machine has its own product page and won a Red Dot design award in 2024, early positive signals that justify keeping it and investing further.
